_readme: GAME CONTENT, DRAFT PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (every name; no art yet: ArtKey is a placeholder key). Cosmetics are PURELY visual (no stats). Looks are PER SPECIES (each beast species has its own categories: two or three parts, e.g. wings where it has them, and a tint colour; lead/user decision) plus the avatar's categories. Category ids are global (unlock keys are 'categoryId/optionId', account-wide). Each discrete category has exactly one default (Source default) and at least one starter look (free from the start); the rest come from: shop (the Trader sells it, from MinRegion; common or rare price tier), boss (a region lair's first clear, UnlockId = the region; never sold), milestone (UnlockId = a Milestones entry: BeastLevel = a beast of that species reaches the level (any beast for an avatar look), AvatarLevel, BossesCleared), drop (a low chance per won battle, drop-tables.json CosmeticDrops, from MinRegion; a future idle/AFK mechanism may also roll it), premium (reserved for a future purchase: never obtainable with gold or play in v1). Colour pickers are free. Validated by CosmeticLibraryValidator; Editor: Beast Craft/Data/Import Cosmetics (categories, the avatar schema, each species' schema). See docs/design/economy-and-shop.md, 'Cosmetics'.

Milestones.DisplayName: Seasoned (a beast of the species reaches level 25)
